title: Amethyst Resonance
description: Gear that makes the sculk world ignore you, an amethyst tier with resonance perks.
body:
![Amethyst Resonance Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8aa359ab00df674998be91542da81c00eecee684.png)

**Gear that makes the sculk world ignore you.**

Craft a full tier of amethyst equipment whose value isn't bigger numbers — it's *resonance*: the crystal absorbs the vibrations that give you away.

![Armor and Items display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b476468bd1ddf5db1d4ec3e428e951943069872.png)

## ✨ The perks

| Perk | What it does |
|---|---|
| 🔇 **Vibration Dampening** | Each armor piece gives a 25% chance that sculk sensors miss your vibrations. **Full set: sensors, calibrated sensors and shriekers ignore you completely** — even stepping right on them. |
| ⛏️ **Silent Mining** | The Resonant Pickaxe masks the vibrations of its own mining. No armor needed — your first safe tool for the deep dark. |
| 👁️ **Serene Gaze** | Wearing the Resonant Helmet, looking an enderman in the eyes no longer provokes it. The carved pumpkin effect, without the pumpkin on your face. |
| 💜 **Muffled Presence** | The Warden's anger toward you builds 15% slower per armor piece (60% slower with the full set). |
| 💎 **Crystal Affinity** | Resonant tools mine crystal and glass blocks much faster, and amethyst clusters drop an extra shard when mined with the Resonant Pickaxe. |
| 🛠️ **Resonance Infusion** | Love your current armor? Find the **Resonance Upgrade** smithing template in ancient cities (duplicable) and infuse ANY armor piece with a Resonant Crystal — it counts as a resonant piece for every perk, keeping its enchantments and trims. |

## ⚖️ Balance

- Stats sit **between iron and diamond** (diamond-level harvest) — you trade raw numbers for perks.
- **High enchantability** (gold-like): amethyst is magical, and enchants roll better than diamond.
- Progression gated by the deep dark itself: **Resonant Crystals** are crafted from 8 amethyst shards around 1 **echo shard** (yields 4). Your first ancient-city expedition is unprotected — the gear is the reward that makes return trips safe.

![Creative Tab items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1a32e25de1f4526457e9f1aeaa6c4c5a7810cec.png)

## ⚙️ Configuration

Every perk is a toggle (plus tuning values) via **Cloth Config** — config screen on both loaders (ModMenu on Fabric, mod list button on NeoForge). Server-authoritative.

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1** or **26.2** · **NeoForge** or **Fabric** (+ Fabric API)
- **Architectury API** and **Cloth Config** (required on both loaders)
- Required on **client and server**

Localized in English and Spanish.

*Modpacks: permitted — reference the file hosted on this page.*
